name: arcane_lab
_comment: Arcane laboratory, phase 1. Coordinates are features of the placeholder painting (scripts/make_arcane_placeholder.py prints them): shelf surface y=430, candle wicks at y~355, desk surface y=1270, apparatus posts x=430/660, floor circle centre 540,1650 r=240. Re-place every control against the real artwork with the panel's alignment page. Controls draw in document order: the ambient ember field first, then local lights. Deliberately NO lamp / gauge_round / radar here: in a freeform layout those draw only their overlay (an opaque disc, a needle, a sweep), so over a painting with no painted dial face they read as a dark hole or a floating stick.
